description: React component for displaying and managing a list of network devices with filtering, sorting, pagination, and actions such as add, edit, delete, and ping.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches device data from API considering current filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: onSortClick
methods.description: Toggles sorting order for a given field.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Opens confirmation dialog for deleting a device.

methods.name: onPing
methods.description: Pings a device if monitoring is enabled and handles the response.
